notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.5.1 update
notes.content:
The changes since Ver. 2.5.0 are as follows:

[list]
[*] Added "Low CPU Load Mode". Streamers are encouraged to turn it on.
[*] A name has been added to Special Thanks.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.5.0 update
notes.content:
[h2]New Music![/h2]

A new background music, [b]"Enchanted Eight"[/b] by AAAA, has been added to the game!
This music is also added to the "Blastboard - Soundtrack".

[h2]New DLC character is on his way![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605705/7e56cfcda5caa167721bdaa3c7bd1ba46fae9f3a.png[/img]
[b]Casso[/b] is a drinking dragon who frequents Kori's Dravian Bar.
He often laughs at players who drop their cue ball due to Eight Ball.

[h2]Changes since Ver. 2.4.2[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the game could not be abandon in online multiplayer.
[*]Adjusted random recommendation function for multiplayer rules.
[*]Added a function to set proportions of background music.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605705/b427c3162101abe9def9f3bf511c58a6911b11a0.png[/img]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.3.3 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where the cue ball would stop farther away from the guide after Ver. 2.2.5.
[*]When it is Point Ball / Halve Score and the scores are already hidden, now the "(-??)" is displayed on the table too.
[*]Fixed a issue where the penalty might not imposed if the cue ball and an object ball fell at the same time.
[/list]

[h3]Ver. 2.3.4[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the clock layout in the online lobby was corrupted in some environments.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.3.0 update
notes.content:
In Ver. 2.3.0, the Point Ball rules now allow you to choose the form of the Point Multiplier.

[list]
[*] [i]Loop:[/i] it returns to x1 at the end of the last player's turn.
[*] [i]Clamp:[/i] the last player's point multiplier continues.
[*] [i]Unlimited:[/i] the point multiplier continues to increase without limit; this is the default setting since Ver. 2.3.0.
[/list]

Other changes since Ver. 2.2.5 are as follows:

[list]
[*] In the lobby owner's screen, now audience can see the lobby code etc. even while the rule settings dialog is open. In addition, you can toggle the visibility of the lobby code by clicking 'OPEN' sign.
[*] Fixed a new issue in Ver. 2.2.5 about the collisions of balls by wall.
[*] The rule display in the game has been redesigned.
[*] The purple color (without color assist mode) of the color ball is now a little more red.
[/list]

[h3]Ver. 2.3.1[/h3]
[list]
[*]Alleviated an issue where the BGM sometimes being interrupted at the table which have many balls.
[/list]

[h3]Ver. 2.3.2[/h3]
[list]
[*]When it is Point Ball / Halve Score and the scores are already hidden, now the "(-??)" is displayed instead of actual number if the point balance became negative.
[*]Fixed an issue that an unintended layout collapse occurs in the Point Ball rule when the point balance became negative.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.2.5 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*][b]Fixed an issue where the trajectory of the cue ball would often deviate from the guide line when the cue ball was reflected strongly against a wall.[/b]
[*]Since the above problem has been resolved, the update frequency for physics operations has been lowered from 60 fps to 50 fps. Performance improvements can be expected in almost environments.
[*]The particles have been redesigned.
[*]Additional particles and trails are now displayed only if the '3D quality' is better.
[*]Point Ball rule: Fixed an issue where hitting a cue ball toward a object ball while the cue ball is in full contact with the object ball would not result in a judgment of contact with the object ball, and the cue ball would be re-placed.
[*]The help tab is now automatically opened when the mouse cursor is placed on a special ball etc.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.2.4 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a feature that the lobby owner forces to change the turn to the specific player in the Point Ball rule for online pvp. Please use this feature when the game has become unprogressive.
[*] Fixed a issue where the game would become unprogressive if a player disconnected (including kicked) in the Minimal rule of online pvp.
[*] The timeout period before a player is considered disconnected in online pvp has been increased from 1s to 3s. This change may make it harder for players with unstable network environments to drop out.
[*] Slightly alleviated the phenomenon where balls placement would vary greatly from client to client in online pvp when the game load is high.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.2.3 update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the cue ball is shot by dragging the screen when the table number is displayed in the center of the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.2.1 and Ver.2.2.2 updates
notes.content:
[h3]Ver.2.2.1[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in online PvP where the cue ball would rarely disappear at unintended times.
[/list]

[h3]Ver.2.2.2[/h3]
[list]
[*]Lobby code has been changed from 6-digit numbers to 4-digit alphanumeric characters.
[*]The feature to shuffle player numbers in the online PvP lobby has been removed. From this version, the shuffling will be done automatically when the game starts.
[*]Other minor UI issues have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.2.0 update
notes.content:
In ver.2.2.0, you can now choose the Penalty Type for the Point Ball rule.

[list]
[*] [i]Forfeit:[/i] same as before; when the cue ball falls, the points earned for the turn are forfeited.
[*] [i]Forfeit Double:[/i] doubles the amount of forfeit, increasing the risk of a reckless shot.
[*] [i]Halve Score:[/i] when the cue ball falls, the score is halved from the start of the turn.
[/list]

Other changes from ver.2.1.3 are as follows:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the contents of each player's table could differ in online PvP mode.
[*] Some UI layouts have been rearranged in order of frequency of use.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cue ball would sometimes float above a pocket in [i]Static[/i].
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.1.1 - Ver.2.1.3 updates

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.0.3 update
notes.content:
The changes from ver.2.0.2 are as follows.
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where a ball in the immediate vicinity of a pocket could fall into the pocket due to gravity after all the balls had stopped.
[*]Fixed an issue where the arrow would remain visible after the cue ball was shot  in online mode.

notes.title: Notification of Ver.2.0.2 update
notes.content:
The changes from ver.2.0.1 are as follows.
[list]
[*]A digital clock is now displayed in the online lobby.
[*]The steam:// URL have been deprecated and will no longer be displayed. The reason for this is that almost social networking sites do not parse steam:// as a URL, and this URL does not work if the game is already running, which it may create confusion.
[/list]

notes.title: ver.2.0.0 Streamer's Update
notes.content:
Blastboard's online multiplayer has been revamped from the ground up to make it much easier to invite and more stable!
Participants do not need to be Steam friends with the lobby owner, just need to enter a 6-digit lobby code to join the game.

This update is specifically designed for [u]streaming of viewers participation[/u], so adds security features for playing with non-friends. Lobby owners can now use the feature to kick neglected members. Also, if the communication with a member is disconnected during a game, the member's turn will be skipped and the game will continue.

Other changes from ver. 1.1.1 are as follows:
[list]
[*]A lot of bugs of online multiplayer related with the old communication system have been fixed.
[*]The interval to determine if all the object balls have disappeared has been changed from 0.1 seconds to 1 frame. This will shorten the waiting time until the "Cleared!" is displayed.
[*]You can now set multiplayer's recommended rule.
[*]The appearance of the UI has been changed.
[/list]

[h3]ver.2.0.1[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue that the weight of the cue ball was not displayed correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Notification of Ver.1.1.1 update

The changes from ver.1.1.0 are as follows.

notes.title: Notification of Ver.1.1.0 update
notes.content:
The changes from ver.1.0.1 are as follows.
[list]
[*]Score increments are now displayed in PvP mode.
[*]In PvP mode, a star is now displayed before the name of the active player.
[*]Changed default number of rounds from 5 to 4 in PvP rule settings.
[*]Added the function to revert PvP rule settings to the default values.
[*]Fixed an online PvP issue that some object balls may not vanish even though "Cleared!" is displayed.
[*]Minimum number of object balls was increased in PvP mode.
[*]Maximum number of colors (of color balls) was decreased from 6 to 5 in PvP mode.
[/list]
